Three-quarter view on seamless warm white studio surface, whole box visible with breathing room, soft contact shadow. Design concept only, not an existing branded package. Square web-quality photo.

acceptance.scene: Reference mint carton on shore, entire sky and ground melting into glowing orange-pink-gold liquid sunset waves, flowing sun reflections and viscous gradients. Lower box softly blends into liquid while upper leaf face remains recognizable. No text.
acceptance.effect: 紙盒場景融入液態夕陽
acceptance.relations: 位置、比例、箭頭、步驟與視角符合原指令
acceptance.details: 指定文字、數字及物件數正確，無多餘水印或宣稱
